en.cta.title: Build something that truly belongs to you.

en.footer.tagline: Open code, explicit architecture, and a render stack you can actually reason about.
en.hero.subtitle: C++/Vulkan runtime today · Python-first authoring · multi-platform roadmap
en.home.capabilities.ai.body: The editor-side MCP Harness can operate a visible project through public workflows, inject frame-bounded input, inspect semantic state, and report blockers. It supports small AI-authored, human-reviewed iterations without being embedded in exported games.
en.home.capabilities.ai.title: MCP Harness for real editor workflows
en.home.capabilities.animation.body: 2D clips, sprite playback, embedded FBX takes, skeletal animation, skinned meshes, reusable state-machine graphs, and Timeline authoring share the same document and interaction foundation.
en.home.capabilities.animation.title: 2D / 3D animation stack
en.home.capabilities.asset.body: GUID identity, dependency indexing, imported Library artifacts, live previews, transactional documents, and a structured Player export keep authoring data separate from runtime content.
en.home.capabilities.asset.title: Asset & project pipeline
en.home.capabilities.editor.body: Hierarchy, Inspector, Scene/Game views, Project, Console, UI, animation, Timeline and graph editors now converge on shared selection, commands, shortcuts, documents, save and undo/redo services.
en.home.capabilities.editor.title: 12-panel editor shell
en.home.capabilities.intro: Version 0.3.6 unifies scene and UI authoring in one Hierarchy and restores automatic update discovery in packaged Hub builds. The engine remains in active development, and breaking improvements are still possible.
en.home.capabilities.physics.body: Rigid bodies, colliders, scene queries, collision callbacks, layer filtering, and scene-synchronized transforms backed by Jolt Physics.
en.home.capabilities.physics.title: Jolt rigid bodies
en.home.capabilities.render.body: Forward, Forward+ and Deferred routes, PBR, per-camera shadows, MSAA, reusable Effect assets, structured GLSL, RenderGraph scheduling, and a Python-programmable RenderStack.
en.home.capabilities.render.title: Vulkan render core
en.home.capabilities.vfx.body: GPU Particle Graph combines emitter settings with Init, Update and Rendering stages, compiles typed graphs to runtime IR ahead of time, and supports sprite/mesh outputs, editor preview and live parameters.
en.home.capabilities.vfx.title: Particle Graph and GPU simulation
en.home.capabilities.script.body: Unity-style component lifecycle, serialized inspector fields, decorators, input APIs, coroutines, prefabs, hot-reload, and a built-in @njit decorator that opts in to Numba JIT with automatic pure-Python fallback.
en.home.capabilities.script.title: Python gameplay layer
en.home.capabilities.title: Where the engine stands today.
en.home.demo.intro: This real editor capture combines standard scene objects, shared lit rendering, per-camera shadows, and a custom RenderStack tilt-shift treatment in one authored scene.
en.home.demo.panel.item1: 65,536 standard GameObjects share one mesh and material while remaining part of the regular Scene and Hierarchy model.
en.home.demo.panel.item2: A custom RenderStack pipeline applies tilt-shift focus, distance and height fog, color controls, and MSAA without leaving the editor workflow.
en.home.demo.panel.item3: This is a real 1920 × 1032 editor capture from the 0.3.4 technology showcase, not a mock-up or offline render.
en.home.demo.panel.title: What this capture demonstrates
en.home.demo.title: A 65,536-object voxel continent authored and rendered inside Infernux.
en.home.hero.description: Infernux is an experimental general-purpose game engine: a C++17/Vulkan runtime with Python 3.12 as a first-class development interface. Android, Web, Linux, and the deeper AI data plane are roadmap work, not current claims.
en.home.hero.kicker: Open source · MIT · Windows x64 available now
en.home.hero.platform: Windows 10/11 x64 · Infernux 0.3.6 · broader platforms in development
en.home.hero.title: Build games with Python. Run them on a native core.
en.home.manifesto: An AI-native engine needs more than a chat panel. It needs authoritative semantics, reproducible worlds, high-throughput model data, and governed tools. Infernux is building those foundations on top of a usable general game engine.
en.home.status.card1.body: Version 0.3.6 removes the separate Hierarchy UI mode, restores packaged Hub update checks, and publishes independently installable full Hub packages.
en.home.status.card1.title: Unified authoring and reliable updates
en.home.status.card2.body: The current cycle prioritizes Android/Web game packages and Torch workflows, then Linux/headless, authoritative schemas, replayable batch worlds, tensor exchange, and governed Engine Tools.
en.home.status.card2.title: Cross-platform shipping and AI-native contracts
en.home.status.intro: Use 0.3.6 as a Windows x64 foundation. Treat Android, Web, Linux, Torch Player inference, replay, batch simulation, and formal Agent tools as planned until their release gates pass.
en.home.status.title: A verified baseline and an explicit next gate.
en.home.system.card1.body: Scenes, assets, rendering, physics, UI, animation, editor workflows, and Player packaging remain the product foundation. AI work must improve this engine rather than become a disconnected demo stack.
en.home.system.card1.title: Principle I · General engine first
en.home.system.card2.body: Python is the public development surface for gameplay, tools, automation, render authoring, and ML workflows; native code owns the performance-sensitive runtime and deployment boundary.
en.home.system.card2.title: Principle II · Python is a production interface
en.home.system.card3.body: UI, Python, MCP, and future agents should consume shared schemas, state transitions, observations, and permissions instead of duplicating engine behavior behind separate adapters.
en.home.system.card3.title: Principle III · AI enters through contracts
en.home.system.intro: The architecture is meant to join ordinary game production with model and agent workflows without confusing current features with future research goals.
en.home.system.title: One engine, three non-negotiable boundaries.
en.pageTitle.index: 熔炉 · Infernux — Open game engine
en.roadmap.hero.description: A gated plan for cross-platform Players, Torch workflows, reproducible worlds, and governed agent tools. No target date is implied.
en.roadmap.hero.title: Infernux roadmap
en.roadmap.lanes.card1.item1: Android APK/AAB and deployable Web game packages from the same project.
en.roadmap.lanes.card1.item2: Linux Player plus windowless and offscreen execution for CI, servers, and simulation.
en.roadmap.lanes.card1.item3: Explicit platform capabilities instead of silent semantic fallback.
en.roadmap.lanes.card1.title: Shipping track
en.roadmap.lanes.card2.item1: Standard PyTorch in the Host/Editor for development, training, evaluation, and export.
en.roadmap.lanes.card2.item2: Platform inference runtimes in Players without requiring ordinary users to install a CUDA Toolkit.
en.roadmap.lanes.card2.item3: Measured Torch/DLPack/buffer interchange with documented copy boundaries.
en.roadmap.lanes.card2.title: Model data track
en.roadmap.lanes.card3.item1: Versioned reflection plus Command/Query schemas shared by UI, Python, and MCP.
en.roadmap.lanes.card3.item2: World snapshot/delta, deterministic replay contracts, and batched create/step/reset.
en.roadmap.lanes.card3.title: Semantic world track
en.roadmap.lanes.card4.item1: Engine Tools with schemas, permissions, tests, provenance, resource limits, and lifecycle.
en.roadmap.lanes.card4.item2: Versioned tasks, evaluators, baselines, and replay packages for research use.
en.roadmap.lanes.card4.item3: Research claims only after reproducibility and held-out evaluation gates exist.
en.roadmap.lanes.card4.title: Trust and research track
en.roadmap.lanes.intro: The tracks share infrastructure: platform contracts shape Players, schemas shape control, replay shapes debugging and science, and tool governance shapes both plugins and agents.
en.roadmap.lanes.title: Four tracks, one end-to-end system.
en.roadmap.priorities.card1.body: Produce the first installable APK on physical hardware with lifecycle, input, assets, audio, rendering, logs, and a minimal portable scripting contract.
en.roadmap.priorities.card1.title: Android Player vertical slice
en.roadmap.priorities.card2.body: Validate the Web native-module, Python, rendering, storage, and packaging boundary before promising compatibility or performance.
en.roadmap.priorities.card2.title: Web portability gate
en.roadmap.priorities.card3.body: Keep native PyTorch on the Host; compare real Android and Web inference providers using model coverage, latency, memory, package size, fallback behavior, and maintenance cost.
en.roadmap.priorities.card3.title: Torch entry and inference decision
en.roadmap.priorities.intro: The immediate work must close real shipping loops. Architecture documents or isolated demos do not pass a release gate by themselves.
en.roadmap.priorities.title: The next three gates.
en.roadmap.release.current.item1: The current release unifies scene and UI objects in one Hierarchy and restores automatic update discovery in packaged Hub builds.
en.roadmap.release.current.item2: It keeps the Windows x64 editor and Player as the verified public baseline while the next platform work is prepared.
en.roadmap.release.current.title: Unified Hierarchy and Hub updates
en.roadmap.release.long.item1: 0.5.0 formalizes Engine Tools and the trusted/untrusted execution boundary; 0.5.1 publishes a reproducible benchmark alpha.
en.roadmap.release.long.item2: 0.5.2 must demonstrate one documented path joining cross-platform Players, models, schemas, replay, batching, and governed tools.
en.roadmap.release.long.title: Governed tools and research system
en.roadmap.release.mid.item1: 0.4.1 adds Linux/headless; 0.4.2 establishes authoritative schemas; 0.4.3 adds snapshot/delta/replay; 0.4.4 adds batch worlds and the tensor data plane.
en.roadmap.release.mid.item2: Each milestone must expose versioned contracts and measurable acceptance evidence, not a private demo-only path.
en.roadmap.release.mid.title: Headless, semantics, replay, and batch data
en.roadmap.release.next.item1: 0.3.7 targets an Android Player vertical slice; 0.3.8 hardens Android inference and packaging; 0.4.0 requires the same project to ship on Android and Web.
en.roadmap.release.next.item2: Torch is a vertical capability across these gates: native ecosystem in the Host, platform inference runtime in each Player.
en.roadmap.release.next.title: Android, Web, and Torch

zh.home.capabilities.ai.title: 面向真实编辑流程的 MCP Harness
zh.home.capabilities.animation.body: 2D 片段、Sprite 播放、FBX 内嵌动作、骨骼动画、蒙皮网格、可复用状态机图与 Timeline 创作正在接入同一套文档和交互基础。
zh.home.capabilities.animation.title: 2D / 3D 动画栈
zh.home.capabilities.asset.body: GUID 身份、依赖索引、Library 导入制品、实时预览、事务化文档与结构化 Player 导出，让编辑源数据和运行时内容保持分离。
zh.home.capabilities.asset.title: 资产与项目管线
zh.home.capabilities.editor.body: Hierarchy、Inspector、Scene/Game、Project、Console、UI、动画、Timeline 与节点编辑器正在统一到共享的选择、命令、快捷键、文档、保存及撤销回退服务。
zh.home.capabilities.editor.title: 12 面板编辑器外壳
zh.home.capabilities.intro: 0.3.6 将场景与 UI 创作统一到同一个 Hierarchy，并恢复打包版 Hub 的自动更新发现。引擎仍处于快速开发阶段，也仍会接受必要的破坏性改进。
zh.home.capabilities.physics.body: 刚体、碰撞体、场景查询、碰撞回调、层过滤与场景同步变换，全部基于 Jolt Physics。
zh.home.capabilities.physics.title: Jolt 刚体物理
zh.home.capabilities.render.body: Forward、Forward+ 与 Deferred 路由、PBR、逐相机阴影、MSAA、可复用 Effect、结构化 GLSL、RenderGraph 调度，以及可由 Python 编排的 RenderStack。
zh.home.capabilities.render.title: Vulkan 渲染内核
zh.home.capabilities.vfx.body: GPU Particle Graph 将发射设置与 Init、Update、Rendering 阶段组合起来，把类型化图提前编译成运行时 IR，并支持 Sprite/Mesh 输出、编辑器预览与实时参数。
zh.home.capabilities.vfx.title: Particle Graph 与 GPU 模拟
zh.home.capabilities.script.body: 类 Unity 的组件生命周期、Inspector 可见的序列化字段、装饰器、输入 API、协程、预制体、热重载，以及内置 @njit 装饰器：自动接入 Numba JIT，并在不可用时降级为纯 Python。
zh.home.capabilities.script.title: Python 玩法层
zh.home.capabilities.title: 引擎现状。

zh.home.hero.badge: INFERNUX 0.3.6 · 当前 WINDOWS 基线
zh.home.hero.description: Infernux（熔炉）是一款实验性通用游戏引擎：以 C++17/Vulkan 作为运行时，以 Python 3.12 作为一等开发界面。Android、Web、Linux 与更深入的 AI 数据面仍属于路线图，不是当前能力。
zh.home.hero.kicker: 开源 · MIT · 当前可用 WINDOWS X64
zh.home.hero.moreActions: 探索 Infernux 的更多方式
zh.home.hero.platform: Windows 10/11 x64 · Infernux 0.3.6 · 更多平台正在开发
zh.home.hero.title: 用 Python 创作游戏，以原生内核运行。
zh.home.manifesto: AI-native 引擎不能只有聊天框，还需要权威语义、可复现世界、高吞吐模型数据和受治理工具。Infernux 正在一套可用的通用游戏引擎底座上建设这些能力。
zh.home.status.card1.body: 0.3.6 移除了独立的 Hierarchy UI 模式，恢复打包版 Hub 更新检查，并发布可独立安装的完整 Hub 包。
zh.home.status.card1.title: 统一创作与可靠更新
zh.home.status.card2.body: 本轮优先完成 Android/Web 游戏包体与 Torch 工作流，再推进 Linux/Headless、权威 schema、可 replay 的批量世界、张量交换与受治理 Engine Tool。
zh.home.status.card2.title: 跨平台发布与 AI-native 契约
zh.home.status.intro: 0.3.6 是 Windows x64 基线。Android、Web、Linux、Torch Player 推理、replay、批量仿真和正式 Agent 工具在通过各自 Release Gate 前都应视为计划。
zh.home.status.title: 一个经过验证的基线，一组明确的下一关口。
zh.home.system.card1.body: 场景、资产、渲染、物理、UI、动画、编辑器工作流与 Player 打包始终是产品底座。AI 工作必须改善这台引擎，而不是变成互不相干的演示栈。
zh.home.system.card1.title: 原则 I · 首先是通用引擎
zh.home.system.card2.body: Python 是玩法、工具、自动化、渲染创作和机器学习工作流的公开生产界面；原生代码负责性能敏感的运行时与部署边界。
zh.home.system.card2.title: 原则 II · Python 是生产界面
zh.home.system.card3.body: UI、Python、MCP 和未来 Agent 应共用 schema、状态转换、观测和权限，而不是在不同适配层里重复实现引擎行为。
zh.home.system.card3.title: 原则 III · AI 通过契约进入
zh.home.system.intro: 架构需要把普通游戏生产与模型、Agent 工作流连接起来，同时严格区分当前功能和未来研究目标。
zh.home.system.title: 一台引擎，三个不可妥协的边界。

zh.roadmap.hero.description: 一份以 Release Gate 为准的计划：跨平台 Player、Torch 工作流、可复现世界与受治理 Agent 工具。这里不暗示发布日期。
zh.roadmap.hero.title: Infernux 路线图
zh.roadmap.lanes.card1.item1: 同一项目导出 Android APK/AAB 与可部署 Web 游戏包体。
zh.roadmap.lanes.card1.item2: Linux Player、无窗口与离屏执行，服务 CI、服务器和仿真。
zh.roadmap.lanes.card1.item3: 显式平台能力报告，禁止静默改变语义。
zh.roadmap.lanes.card1.title: 发布线
zh.roadmap.lanes.card2.item1: Host/Editor 直接使用标准 PyTorch 做开发、训练、评估和导出。
zh.roadmap.lanes.card2.item2: Player 携带平台推理运行时，不要求普通用户安装 CUDA Toolkit。
zh.roadmap.lanes.card2.item3: 测量 Torch/DLPack/buffer 交换，并记录每个复制边界。
zh.roadmap.lanes.card2.title: 模型数据线
zh.roadmap.lanes.card3.item1: UI、Python 与 MCP 共用版本化反射和 Command/Query schema。
zh.roadmap.lanes.card3.item2: 世界 snapshot/delta、确定性 replay 契约与批量 create/step/reset。
zh.roadmap.lanes.card3.title: 语义世界线
zh.roadmap.lanes.card4.item1: Engine Tool 具备 schema、权限、测试、来源、资源限制和生命周期。
zh.roadmap.lanes.card4.item2: 面向研究的版本化任务、评估器、baseline 与 replay 复现包。
zh.roadmap.lanes.card4.item3: 在具备可复现与 held-out 评估关口前，不提前宣称 benchmark 已完成。
zh.roadmap.lanes.card4.title: 信任与研究线
zh.roadmap.lanes.intro: 四条线共用基础设施：平台契约约束 Player，schema 约束控制，replay 同时服务调试与科研，工具治理同时服务插件和 Agent。
zh.roadmap.lanes.title: 四条路线，一个端到端系统。
zh.roadmap.priorities.card1.body: 在真实设备安装首个 APK，打通生命周期、输入、资产、音频、渲染、日志和最小可移植脚本契约。
zh.roadmap.priorities.card1.title: Android Player 垂直切片
zh.roadmap.priorities.card2.body: 先验证 Web 原生模块、Python、渲染、存储与打包边界，再承诺兼容性或性能。
zh.roadmap.priorities.card2.title: Web 可移植性关口
zh.roadmap.priorities.card3.body: Host 保留原生 PyTorch；以模型覆盖、延迟、内存、包体、fallback 与维护成本比较真实 Android/Web 推理 provider。
zh.roadmap.priorities.card3.title: Torch 入口与推理决策
zh.roadmap.priorities.intro: 近期工作必须闭合真实发布链路。只有架构文档或孤立 demo，不能通过版本关口。
zh.roadmap.priorities.title: 接下来的三个关口。
zh.roadmap.release.current.item1: 当前版本将场景与 UI 对象统一到同一个 Hierarchy，并恢复打包版 Hub 的自动更新发现。
zh.roadmap.release.current.item2: Windows x64 编辑器与 Player 是当前经过验证的公开基线，下一阶段的平台工作正在准备。
zh.roadmap.release.current.title: 统一 Hierarchy 与 Hub 更新
zh.roadmap.release.long.item1: 0.5.0 正式化 Engine Tool 与可信/不可信执行边界；0.5.1 发布可复现 Bench Alpha。
zh.roadmap.release.long.item2: 0.5.2 必须展示一条把跨平台 Player、模型、schema、replay、批量实例与受治理工具连接起来的文档化路径。
zh.roadmap.release.long.title: 受治理工具与科研系统
zh.roadmap.release.mid.item1: 0.4.1 加入 Linux/Headless；0.4.2 建立权威 schema；0.4.3 加入 snapshot/delta/replay；0.4.4 加入批量世界与张量数据面。
zh.roadmap.release.mid.item2: 每个里程碑都必须提供版本化契约与可测量验收证据，不能只存在于私有演示路径。
zh.roadmap.release.mid.title: Headless、语义、Replay 与批量数据
zh.roadmap.release.next.item1: 0.3.7 交付 Android Player 垂直切片；0.3.8 强化 Android 推理与打包；0.4.0 要求同一项目同时发布 Android 与 Web。
zh.roadmap.release.next.item2: Torch 贯穿这些关口：Host 使用原生生态，各 Player 使用平台推理运行时。
zh.roadmap.release.next.title: Android、Web 与 Torch
